functions.name: Scene.Frame.MarkDirty
functions.summary: Queue the frame hierarchy for the original RenderWare update.

evidence.quote:
Entity virtual +28 is the position setter. `sub_82696D10(entity, position)` writes
the three translation words at frame +64, calls `sub_823F2460(frame)` to queue a
RenderWare update, then dispatches entity virtual +92. The base notification
`sub_82697160` marks entity +202 bit `0x0800` and notifies a non-null model at +136
through `sub_826A8708(model, 1)`. Calling only the base setter skips overrides:
the character setter `sub_8288D2E0` also calls controller +784, virtual +60, with
the position and flag 0. The ScriptableProp and all four family vtables observed
in a private Linux GAME_HUB run agree on setter slot +28 and notification +92.

functions.name: Scene.Frame.UpdateWorldMatrix
functions.summary: Update parent world matrices recursively before composing a child.

evidence.quote:
The frame at entity +140 stores its modelling matrix at +16 and cached world
matrix at +80. Parent is frame +4; hierarchy root is frame +160.
`sub_823F2540(frame)` returns the modelling matrix for a root or the resolved
world matrix for a child. It inspects the root's dirty flag and updates parent
matrices through `sub_823F24D8` before composing the child. A root's cached world
matrix can be stale even when its modelling matrix is current; copying either
translation directly is not a substitute for the getter.

functions.name: Entity.DeliverMessage
functions.summary: Preserve activation, virtual delivery and deferred subscriber retirement.

evidence.quote:
Delivery follows original synchronous hit producers such as `sub_82883888`:
`sub_8268FAA8(message-global, entity +56, damage-info, 0)` constructs the borrowed
message and calls `sub_8268F998`. That dispatcher respects subscriber +4 bit 0,
enters the entity's virtual handler and preserves message-type dispatch flags
and deferred subscriber retirement. Entering only the health receiver would
omit other listening components and the subscriber activation check. The
adapter uses this original dispatcher for both damage and healing, without the
force flag. The native fixture also executes both unchanged dispatch routines;
its synthetic entity receiver is an explicit scene boundary.

functions.name: Entity.Scene.AttachModel

evidence.quote:

functions.name: Entity.ForEachComponent

`sub_8269AD58` walks the component pointer array at entity +52, entries 1 through

functions.name: Entity.DestroyBase
functions.summary: Release the base factory bank and unregister the entity; mod lifetime identities expire before this routine.

evidence.quote:
The base destructor `sub_8269BC10` releases its factory bank and, when required,
calls `sub_826A16F8(world, entity)`. That unregister routine removes the direct GUID
entry, decrements world +164 and unlinks entity +12/+16 and +4/+8. The handwritten
base-destructor hook invalidates host lifetime identities before the original runs.
No mod callbacks or guest calls run from that bookkeeping hook.

functions.name: World.DestroyEntity
functions.summary: Dispatch an entity through its complete deleting destructor or subscriber removal path.

evidence.quote:
`sub_8269F990(entity)` is the original single-object destruction dispatcher. For
flag `0x08000000` it calls `sub_8268F538(entity +56)`, which sends the destruction
message through subscriber virtual +4 and calls subscriber deleting virtual +0
with flag 1. Other objects call their own deleting virtual +0 with flag 1. World
cleanup routines `sub_826A20E0` and `sub_826A2468` use the same dispatch. Calling a
base destructor directly would skip class-specific physics and component cleanup.

functions.name: Streams.StoredSize
functions.summary: Compute the total stored archive size from its entry sizes.

evidence.quote:
Payloads start at file offset 2,048, in entry order. Each file offset is 2,048 plus preceding
stored sizes. `sub_826C3708` reads entry[+16] bytes into the buffer at entry[+20].
`sub_826C36D0` computes total size using the same stored-size sum.

`sub_826C6D20` resolves the +0 pool through `sub_826C5548` before allocating +12 bytes.

functions.name: Streams.FindAllocationPool

functions.name: Assets.Mesh.BuildDeclaration
functions.summary: Cache and forward a preinstanced mesh declaration to the original native constructor.

evidence.quote:
Stream 0, semantic `0x00030000`, declaration type `0x002A2187` supplies a
big-endian packed normal. XYZ occupy signed ten-bit fields starting at bits
0, 10 and 20. Decode each with division by 511 and clamp the alternate -512
encoding to -1. The upper two bits are preserved. This agrees with the signed
normalized `k_2_10_10_10` fetch representation in `graphics/xenos.h` and
`graphics/pipeline/shader/interpreter.cpp`; `sub_82701BD8` forwards the original
declaration to the native vertex declaration constructor.

functions.name: Camera.BuildViewWindow
functions.summary: Compute native view-window extents with projection flags, raster aspect and interlaced video.

evidence.quote:
`sub_82714588` computes a view window from tan(lens angle / 2), the video mode,
camera raster dimensions and two byte flags. Its vertical-preserving branch
multiplies by the shipped 0.5625 widescreen or 0.75 standard factor; the other
branch derives vertical extent from the raster aspect. Interlaced fields
double the effective height. The director's input angle therefore is not
unconditionally an actual vertical field of view.

functions.name: Assets.Model.CopyMatrixValue
functions.summary: Copy the sixteen-float native model matrix property.

evidence.quote:
Property records contain the value at +0, name and owner/class strings at +4
and +8, a name hash at +16 and the native type at +20. The original relocator
fixes the value only when `type & 0x1B8` is nonzero. Reviewed types are unsigned
32-bit integers (2), floats (4), strings (8), resource references (16), matrices
(32) and three-component vectors (128). A matrix holds sixteen floats; a vector
holds three. `sub_82719360` and `sub_827193D0` copy those respective layouts.
Other kinds remain preserved, and unreviewed pointees prevent overlapping edits.

functions.name: RefPack.ReadSize
functions.summary: Read and advance a resource size header through its input cursor.

evidence.quote:
`sub_8281E8C0` reads the size header through the input-cursor pointer in r3, advances that
